property_summary: After any play() call, the contract's ETH balance must be exactly pot + FEE_AMOUNT if the payout branch was taken, otherwise balance must equal pot; the mutant shifts the payout condition, so when random != 0, it takes the payout branch and leaves balance == 0 while pot == 0 (breaking the invariant that balance >= pot).
change_summary: Change the random condition from == 0 to != 0 so the payout logic shifts to the opposite branch.
